title: Gen Z protests sweep cities across Germany
summary: Young people in Germany have taken to the streets in some 34 cities, calling for greater political say and a more hopeful future. The protests come amid a wave of youth demonstrations across Europe.…

image.caption: The initiative is calling for stronger climate action and affordable living while opposing military conscriptionImage: Marcus Brandt/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Hamburg: Protesters set fire to barriers

blocks.caption: Police said they used a water cannon to extinguish the fire Image: Marius Bulling/onw-images/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: In Germany's second-biggest city, Hamburg, police estimated 6,700 people taking part in the demonstration.

They reported some groups of black-clad protesters, some of whom also wore face masks, pulling apart construction site barriers and throwing them on the street. Some of the barriers were later set on fire.
Police said they pushed the crowd back and used pepper spray to break them apart. The fire was eventually put out.
